title: South32 sees limited risk of Indonesia replicating nickel success in alumina
body: South32 reported a 75% surge in full-year profit on Thursday, helped by strong performance at its alumina division and higher commodity prices.

title: Freeport Indonesia to wrap up Gresik plant repairs by early September
body: Freeport expects to complete early next month repair work at its JV smelter in East Java.

title: Indonesia scraps coal pricing rules after pushback from buyers
body: Miners will now be allowed to sell below government-set benchmarks.

title: Freeport Indonesia to ramp up concentrate exports ahead of ban
body: The firm has exported about 65% of the quota as of mid-August.

title: Nickel surpasses coal as Indonesia’s top export, Macquarie says
body: Earnings from overseas sales of nickel products were $16.5 billion in the first half of the year.

title: Indonesia mining ministry proposes 18 development projects for Danantara funding
body: Danantara is Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto's main vehicle to achieve his 8% economic growth target by 2029.

title: Indonesian Nickel Mining Industry Faces Challenges with B40 Implementation and Decreasing Nickel Prices
body: The Indonesian nickel mining industry is experiencing significant challenges due to the implementation of B40, with production costs increasing by 3-5% and nickel prices reaching a 10-year low of $15,000 per metric ton. The Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI) is calling for a comprehensive evaluation of the B40 policy, citing concerns over supply chain disruptions, decreased profit margins, and reduced tax revenues.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia Releases Nickel Price Reference for September 2025
body: The Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI) has announced a decrease in the nickel price reference for the period of September 2025, with the price set at $14.899,64 per dry metric ton, down from $15.012,67 per dry metric ton in the previous period. The association also provided detailed pricing for nickel ore with varying moisture content and nickel grades, ranging from 1.60% to 2.00%.

title: Global Nickel Prices Remain Stable, Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate Sees Significant Increase
body: The Indonesia Nickel Price Index reported stable global nickel prices, with Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate (MHP) experiencing a significant increase of $97 per metric ton to $12,883 per metric ton, driven by growing demand from the Asian battery industry for electric vehicles. Nickel ore prices remained unchanged, with 1.2% and 1.6% grade ores trading at $24.5 and $52.15 per metric ton, respectively.

title: Indonesia's Nickel Industry Faces Trilemma in Implementing Environmental, Social, and Governance Standards
body: Indonesia's nickel industry is expected to face a trilemma of global demand, community price, and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) standards, with companies like PT Vale Indonesia and Ceria Corp already implementing ESG standards and remaining profitable. The industry aims to achieve a win-win situation by adopting ESG standards, with a focus on reducing carbon emissions, such as Vale's 28.7 ton CO2 per ton nickel, and developing a green nickel market.

title: Indonesian Nickel Mining Sector Faces Challenges from Illegal Mining and ESG Concerns
body: The Indonesian nickel mining sector is struggling with the issue of illegal mining, which is hindering the implementation of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles, with 11 community members currently facing legal action for protesting against the practice. The Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia (APNI) is working to address these issues by synchronizing regulations with international ESG standards and promoting stakeholder engagement to achieve a more sustainable and low-carbon nickel industry.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia Holds Training to Miners 2025, Receives Positive Response from National Mining Industry Players
body: The Training to Miners (TTM) APNI 2025 event, held by the Indonesian Nickel Miners Association, provided a platform for national mining industry players to update their knowledge on the latest regulations and industry conditions, with participants expressing appreciation for the informative event. The event also highlighted the challenges faced by the mining sector, including increasing regulatory burdens and declining commodity prices, which are affecting profit margins and requiring companies to adapt to remain competitive.

title: Indonesian Mining Industry Faces Challenges Amid Global Dynamics, with Nickel and Coal Sectors Experiencing Significant Slowdown
body: The Indonesian mining industry, particularly the nickel and coal sectors, is currently experiencing a significant slowdown due to global price dynamics and geopolitical factors, with nickel reserves reaching 5.9 billion tons and annual production of 250 million tons. Despite the challenges, the gold sector is showing a positive trend, with profits reaching Rp5.1 trillion by June 2025, and the industry is urged to enhance competencies and adapt to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategies to remain competitive.

title: Kementerian ESDM Tetapkan Harga Indeks Pasar Biodiesel untuk Periode September 2025 sebesar Rp 13.948 per liter
body: Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (ESDM) menetapkan Harga Indeks Pasar (HIP) Bahan Bakar Nabati (BBN) jenis biodiesel untuk periode September 2025 sebesar Rp 13.948 per liter, ditambah ongkos angkut yang berlaku efektif mulai 1 September 2025. Penetapan HIP ini didasarkan pada konversi Crude Palm Oil (CPO) menjadi biodiesel sebesar 85 USD/MT dan rata-rata harga CPO KPB periode 25 Juli hingga 24 Agustus 2025 sebesar Rp 14.645 per kilogram.

title: Nilai Ekonomi Karbon membuka peluang ekonomi baru dan meningkatkan efisiensi energi di Indonesia
body: Penerapan Nilai Ekonomi Karbon (NEK) di Indonesia dapat membantu pencapaian target iklim, meningkatkan efisiensi energi, dan mendorong adopsi teknologi rendah karbon, serta membuka peluang ekonomi baru seperti pasar kredit karbon dan penguatan daya saing industri. Dengan demikian, Indonesia dapat mempersiapkan diri menghadapi kebijakan internasional seperti Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) dan meningkatkan ketahanan ekonomi rumah tangga terhadap fluktuasi harga energi di masa depan.

title: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama announces the issuance of its third rupiah conventional bond, Obligasi III BUMA Tahun 2025, with a principal value of up to Rp1.4 trillion
body: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama has announced the issuance of its third rupiah conventional bond, Obligasi III BUMA Tahun 2025, with a principal value of up to Rp1.4 trillion to be used for debt repayment, capital expenditure, and working capital. The bond issuance is part of the company's strategy to diversify its funding sources, reduce risks, and strengthen its financial resilience to support its long-term growth in the mining sector.

title: Kementerian ESDM Allocates Rp8.117 Trillion for Energy Infrastructure Development and Mining Sector Enhancement in 2025
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources has allocated Rp8.117 trillion for energy infrastructure development, including Rp2.9 trillion for gas network expansion and Rp460 billion for solar power plant construction, aiming to enhance energy accessibility and security. The budget also covers initiatives such as education and training programs, with Rp165.6 billion allocated for vocational training in the energy and mining sector, as well as mitigation and disaster management efforts.

title: Indonesia's Energy Policy Requires Long-Term Planning to Avoid Crisis and Ensure Sustainability
body:
Indonesia's energy policy has been criticized for being driven by political motives rather than careful calculation, leading to inconsistent decisions that can have long-term negative impacts on the economy and environment. The government must prioritize data-driven, sustainable, and consistent policies to ensure a stable energy supply, protect the environment, and maintain the country's competitiveness.
